definitions.explanation: A critical evaluation or commentary on a book, typically published in a newspaper, magazine, or academic journal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書評|しょひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}った→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: I became interested after reading the book review in the newspaper.
Writing a book review involves a different kind of difficulty from reading a book.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{書評|しょひょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き→売れ行き：14897_ureyuki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧だ。
examples.english: That author's new work received high praise in reviews and is selling well.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard literary and publishing term. Major Japanese newspapers have dedicated {書評|しょひょう} sections, usually published weekly. Also common in academic contexts for scholarly book reviews.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書評|しょひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a book review
- {書評|しょひょう}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧: book review column/section
- {書評|しょひょう}⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧: book reviewer, book critic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦レビュー→レビュー：11193_rebyuu⟧: review (loanword, used for books, products, etc.)
- ⟦{批評|ひひょう}→批評：03581_hihyou⟧: criticism, critique (broader, not limited to books)
- ⟦{感想|かんそう}{文|ぶん}→感想文：19527_kansoubun⟧: personal impressions/essay (less formal, subjective)
